newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen restarting Weds.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen restarting Weds.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 3 is expected to resume electricity production Wednesday following an unplanned outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Delta, Pa., was "exiting maintenance outage - plan to place unit on line today," the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Wednesday.
Peach Bottom 3 tripped off line Sunday while the unit was operating at reduced power for control rod adjustments.
The adjacent Peach Bottom nuclear unit 2, also with a capacity of 1,100 MW, was operating at full power as of early Wednesday, the NRC said.
